name: mermaid-mcp-app
description: Render Mermaid diagrams in an interactive viewer with pan, zoom, and a built-in source editor.
long_description: An MCP App that renders any Mermaid diagram in an interactive viewer — inline inside the host. Features pan & zoom, fit-to-container, copy SVG, split-view source editor, send edits back to the conversation, draft persistence, and automatic dark/light theme detection. Supports all Mermaid diagram types.

tools.name: render-mermaid
tools.description: Render a Mermaid diagram in an interactive viewer with pan, zoom, and a built-in source editor. The user can edit the diagram and send changes back to the conversation. Supports all Mermaid diagram types.
